=== 1. HEADLINE CONCLUSIONS ===
1. The drawing system sits two folder numbers apart.
   - VV: DrawingViewCore..NorthDirection at 42..47. TV: 40..46.
   - TV numbers 40 and 42-47 name a different system in VV; so does 62.
   - Cause: VV plan D05 (VV/ValeVision__PLAN__TrueVisionPort__LayoutEditor__.md:53) avoided its legacy 40 and 41. TV then fixed its own map (TV/TrueVision__PLAN__ValeVisionRealign__DrawingSystems__.md:304-321).
   - 106 VV files reference these folder names today.
   - Fix once, atomically, before any further port: WP-S01-01, 71 files moved plus 8 legacy files.
2. The LE subfolders already share TV's exact names.
   - Both apps adopted them 15-Sep-2026 (VV v2.47.0, TV v2.55.0; ledger 1113-1143: "A file in one app is at the same path in the other").
   - VV lacks 17 TV subfolders: 21, 26, 27, 28, 31, 32, 33, 36, 37, 51, 52, 53, 54, 58, 59, 65, 66.
   - VV's only extra is 01__Core__Loader, which is permanent.
3. Namespaces and exports are almost aligned.
   - Of 249 paired files in 40-55, one header NAMESPACE differs: 40/Na__DrawView__SectionAdapter__.js. Its exports are identical.
   - VV adds 18 export names TV lacks, in 12 files, all explained: loader, Layout Mode, style toggles, sections filed by type, and one removed by TV.
   - TV has 269 export names VV lacks. Those are features to port, not naming problems.
4. Five file renames are needed so twins share one path; three more need Adam's decision. All are listed in section 5.
5. `--Vale_*` CSS custom properties are a SHARED vocabulary that TV uses too (TV 03__Style__AppStylesheets/Na__UiFeature__Styles__AppHeader__.css:28-35,210-212). They must never be "rebranded".
   - App-specific identifiers are: model category keys TrueVision__*/ValeVision__*; project file names; local-server routes /api/truevision vs /api/valevision; header X-TrueVision-Drawings-Base; Statement storage keys Na__TrueVision__Statement*; public URLs noble-architecture.com/q/ and /s/.
   - 92 TV files carry such literals (identity.json).
6. TV's drawing system imports modules VV does not have:
   - 03/Na__AppUtils__KeyScope__.js (4 importers).
   - 03/Na__AppUtils__LocalProjectMirror__.js (6).
   - 26/Na__ModelGroup__PhaseLibrary__.js (4).

   - 25/Na__DoorAnimation__FindDoorGroups.js (1).
   - 80__CloudflareIntegration/Na__CloudflareIntegration__ApiClient__.js (16).
   - Two ProjectLoader exports VV lacks: GetProjectFolderFromUrl (12 files) and GetYearFromUrl (11).
   - Recommendation: give VV implementations at TV's paths with TV's export names over its own worker and Flask server (D-S01-03).
7. UI: the top-bar fold Adam named is already in VV and in sync.
   - VV v2.70.0 took it from TV v2.83.0. The tokens --Vale_HeaderFold* are identical (TV AppHeader.css 210-212, VV 206-208), and so are the rules body.na-layout-editor--active .app-header / .na-le-tabs / .na-le-host. Only comments differ.
   - The real UI gaps:
     - TabStrip 2.0.0 (TV v2.158.0): five tabs (3D Model | Drawings menu | Specification | Document Register | Design Statements), where VV has one tab per sheet.
     - VV's Layout Mode switch, which TV does not have.

=== 6. NAMING RULEBOOK (the swarm's contract) ===
R1. TV is the numbering authority. A VV folder holding the same system as a TV folder carries TV's exact NN__Category__Name, at top level, in LE subfolders and in nested sub-subfolders.
R2. VV-only folders never take a number TV uses or has used. Legacy goes to 9x. VV-only numbers go in the shared registry.
R3. LE placement: a file's folder follows its base name; split units and __Config__.json files sit with their base. 01__Core__Loader is the only VV-only LE subfolder.
R4. A shared module's file name equals TV's, character for character, legacy names without a trailing __ included. Do not "fix" one side; TV has 77 such legacy files and VV 104, matching pairwise. The header FILE line equals the file name.
R5. Config file names:
   - Top-level system: Na__<System>__AppConfig__.json.
   - LE subsystem or 5x feature: Na__<Prefix>__<Feature>__Config__.json.
   - App-wide: 02__AppData/Na__AppConfig__Main.json.
   - Hotkeys: Na__Hotkeys__3dModelTab__/DrawingTabs__/DocumentTabs__.json.
   - VV-only legacy __Config.json files stay as they are.
R6. Other file kinds:
   - Stylesheets: Na__<System>__Styles__<Role>__.css. VV-only legacy __Stylesheet__.css files stay.
   - Folder READMEs: README__<Topic>__.md.
   - Tests: Na__Test__<Feature>__.test.mjs|.test.cjs|.test.py|.html; Na__TestEnv__<X>Bundle__.cjs; Na__Verify__<X>__.mjs; sandbox TestEnv__*. Ported tests keep TV's names.
R7. Headers:
   - Banner line 2 is "VALEVISION3D - " followed by TV's text verbatim.
   - NAMESPACE and MODULE lines are TV's.
   - PORT NOTE follows VV plan 4.2: Ported from / Source version / Ported on / Parity / Divergences / Back-port.
   - The DEVELOPMENT LOG keeps TV's entries and adds a "Ported from TrueVision3D vX" line.
R8. Namespaces and export names are TV's. A VV-only name is additive (never a rename of a TV export) and is listed under Divergences.
R9. Console prefix: [ValeVision3D <System>], where <System> is exactly TV's.
R10. CSS custom-property names, CSS classes (na-<block>__<el>--<mod>, LE na-le-*), DOM ids (naCamelCase) and window events (na-kebab-case, constants Na__<Ns>__<X>_EVENT) are identical to TV.
   - --Vale_*, --Na_Le_*, --na-le-*, --na-spec-*, --Na_Viewer* are shared.
   - Values may differ for brand.
R11. Browser storage keys are identical, because the apps run on different origins. A key that embeds the app name swaps it:
   - TrueVision3D__AuthoringUnlocked -> ValeVision3D__AuthoringUnlocked (already done).
   - Na__TrueVision__StatementDraft__/Discarded__/View__/Mono__/Last__ -> Na__ValeVision__...
R12. Runtime model category keys are ValeVision__<Category>. SketchUp tag names (e.g. 21__ProposedBuilding__Walls) are shared. Every TrueVision__<Category> literal is a seam, e.g. TVM/LE/07/Na__LayoutEditor__SheetRecords__.js:434, LE/25/Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__.js:98, LE AppConfig PlanDoors__SwingCategoryKeys.

   - TV's numbered content sub-folders (05__Layout__DrawingDocs__Images, 06__Layout__PublishedDocuments) keep their names. The transport slice confirms this.
R14. Local server:

title: Broader UI parity: header fold animation, tab strip, veils, loading screens, toolbar, menus, styles
summary:
The top-bar fold Adam named is already identical in both apps. All seven fold rules in Na__UiFeature__Styles__AppHeader__.css match, and both apps toggle the same body class (na-layout-editor--active) in ModeController Enter and Leave. TV has not touched the fold, veil CSS or LoadingVeil since commit bef15277 on 20-Sep.

Two things still make the experience differ. First, TV v2.158.0's five-tab strip (TabStrip 2.0.0: 3D Model, Drawings menu, Specification, Document Register, Design Statements) adds a quiet entry, so the bar also folds when a document tab is pressed from the 3D view. VV still shows one tab per sheet, and its Specification tab only appears once a sheet is open. Second, on VV's first drawing of a session the lazy loader's opaque full-screen cover (z-index 9999) sits over the header and tabs while they fold. TV instead shows an in-host veil under visible tabs after 550 ms.

VV also has no going-in veil of its own. Once document tabs or Dev actions load the editor first, VV's first drawing will open uncovered.

Other gaps:
- The toolbar still has Undo, Redo, Fit, 100% and Notes, which TV removed in Toolbar 1.17.0 and 1.19.0.
- The panels stylesheet lacks TV's additions, including the one-red layer switches from v2.154.0.
- Context-menu flyouts, the Layer row, hover and note tooltips, and the colour palette popover are TV-only.
- VV lacks Open Sans Medium and loads its fonts from Noble Architecture's web host.
- The toast offset differs: 40 px in TV, 96 px in VV.
- On the 3D tab, VV moves the canvas below the tab strip and TV does not.

TV is the side that is behind on the confirm dialog: it has no markup or CSS for it, so every editor confirm falls back to the browser's window.confirm.

Cross-cutting wiring: every ported TV stylesheet needs a home in VV's lazy loader. Most go in the loader's stylesheet list in TV's order. Pre-editor rules go in Styles__Boot, 54 and 55 go in the CSS index, and self-linking feature sheets need nothing.

The shared Whitecardopedia service-worker token is stale (2026-09-18-1). VV v2.70.0 said it had to be bumped and it was not. A ledger row wrongly says VV has no service worker.

The report covers 36 findings, 14 work packages, 11 decisions, the target stylesheet order and a side-by-side acceptance checklist.

title: Data model, persistence and R2 transport parity (VV keeps its own worker and storage)
summary: S12 (data model, persistence, R2 transport). TV and VV transports are structurally different and must stay so (DIV-4): TV writes through an unauthenticated generic worker (/r2/read|write|list|delete|upload|copy over NaProjectPortal/) plus the ProjectVision Flask server; VV writes through a route-per-feature worker (whitecardopedia-editor-api) whose X-Editor-Api-Key only localhost Flask hands out, so VV authoring is localhost-only. The cheapest route to an identical editor is a VV-authored, same-path, same-name transport facade: VVM/80__CloudflareIntegration/Na__CloudflareIntegration__ApiClient__.js (Na__CfApi, TV's 33 export names, 27 used by 16 TV drawing modules + R2AssetUpload) and VVM/03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__LocalProjectMirror__.js (Na__LocalMirror, 8 names), plus GetProjectFolderFromUrl/GetYearFromUrl in VV's ProjectLoader (imported by 12 TV modules). With it, TV's Transport units (SpecData, Statement, SheetImages, Publish), Lockstep, Register, ProjectData 1.6.0, AutoSave 1.5.0, Assets and Persistence port verbatim or with one-constant seams, and TV's name-stubbed tests port. VV needs one worker deploy (project GET, server-side merge-keys with optional R2 drawings guard, a guarded project-files family over six path families, folderId validation, capability list on /api/editor/health) and Flask work (v2.146 guarded save with fingerprint/409/backups/atomic writes, files/<name>, /api/health, JSON 404 for unknown /api/* because the catch-all answers 200 index.html), then per-feature blueprints (/api/valevision/sheet-images|published|statements|user-config). CRITICAL prerequisites found outside the app: the Whitecardopedia sync run by the SketchUp Cloud Sync plugin purges every R2 image under the project prefix whose basename is not a top-level local file (thumbnails and Layout Editor snapshots today; sheet images, published tiers and statement pictures after the port) and uploads the whole local project.json over R2's editor keys; every VV editor save also bumps the GLOBAL build manifest that cache-busts every GLB for every client. VV has no Na__DevSavedKeys equivalent (disk-only localhost load although it calls R2 the SSOT); recommended one SSOT editor-owned key list used by the overlay, the worker guard and the pipeline. Schema is close (drawings block differs only by TV SavedIso vs VV LayoutModeEnabled; CrossSection__SceneData and per-scene lighting identical); repository URLs must be app-root relative in VV (GitHub Pages sub-path). Found a dormant VV bug (ProjectRecord reads the presentation block, not the project root) and TV back-port items (dev-owned lists lack CrossSection__SceneData and LayoutEditor__DrawingRegister; Register Data hard-codes TV file names; R2 unjudged by TV's save guard; TV worker has no auth and dev CORS). 50 findings, 17 work packages, 8 decisions.
